We got two templates. Need to apply to target molecule to get precursors. The first template (reaction_id 214705) seems to be sulfonamide formation from sulfonyl chloride and amine? Let's examine retro_smarts_template: '[O;D1;H0:2]=[S;H0;D4;+0:1](=[O;D1;H0:3])(-[c:4])-[NH;D2;+0:5]-[c:6]>>O-[S;H0;D4;+0:1](=[O;D1;H0:2])(=[O;D1;H0:3])-[c:4].[NH2;D1;+0:5]-[c:6]'

So retrosynthetic direction: product (sulfonamide) -> precursors: sulfonyl chloride (O-[S](=O)(=O)-aryl) and amine (NH2-aryl). Good.

We need to apply this template to our target molecule (which is a sulfonamide). Use apply_template with template_id maybe the template_hash? The tool expects template_id string. We have template_hash. Likely template_id is that hash. Use apply_template with target SMILES and template_id = '71bec5921e509afa2276e32c9b692dac343f13a5d1e309331f68236288cfd043' (or maybe the reaction_id). We'll try with template_hash.
